questions.urgency: When do you plan to move?
questions.household: Who will live in the property?
questions.employmentDuration: How long have you been in your current employment situation?
questions.guarantor: Do you have a guarantor available?
questions.intent: Have you recently visited any properties?
questions.stayDuration: How long do you intend to stay?
questions.motivation: What are you mainly looking for?
questions.residencyDuration: How long have you resided in this country?

descriptions.urgency: Measures search urgency. Candidates with immediate need score higher.
descriptions.household: Checks if the number of people is within the property's criteria.
descriptions.pets: Relevant for properties with pet restrictions. Includes type and count.
descriptions.income: Evaluates financial capacity against rent value. Candidate enters exact amount.
descriptions.commitments: Total monthly fixed costs. High values penalise financial capacity.
descriptions.job: Permanent contracts score higher. Also determines if guarantor is required.
descriptions.employmentDuration: Indicates income stability. Longer duration contributes positively.
descriptions.guarantor: Having a guarantor unlocks better conditions and compensates other factors.
descriptions.intent: Indicates if the candidate is in an advanced decision-making phase.
descriptions.stayDuration: Candidates with longer intended stays are generally preferred.
descriptions.motivation: Context on the main motivation for moving.
descriptions.nationality: Allows evaluation of candidate's residency stability.
descriptions.residencyDuration: Only asked when nationality differs from agency country. Longer duration scores higher.
